name: Language Model Chat (relay)
description: One chat turn with a PAID language model (xAI Grok first), relayed so the caller never holds the key: the key stays in the owner's vault. Off until the owner switches the provider on and sets a daily cap (Settings > Language models); refused with the reason when off, keyless or capped. Returns text, model, usage (tokens, cost) and a truncated flag, under 5,000 characters.
requires: the owner's llm_provider_xai_enabled switch and an llm_daily_cap_xai above 0
